note: Direction of trade is the critical point here and it cuts against the declared profile. The declared HS codes 842121/842199 (water-treatment / filtration equipment) DO match the goods actually seen — "LEE DI CARTRIDGE FOR WATER TREATMENT" (84212190), "PARTICLE FILTER" and "DI MIXED BED FILTER" (84219900), plus a UV lamp under 85394900 — but the company appears on the BUYER side of that flow, importing Russian-made ELGA/MELVIS water-treatment consumables into India via Sahar Air (Mumbai). ImportKey's own supplier table corroborates this: the counterparty "JOINT-STOCK COMPANY MELVIS" is listed with 8 shipments against KANSARA DIAM LLP. So the firm looks like an importer/distributor of filtration consumables, not an exporter of them. No evidence of any export shipment and no evidence of domestic supply (no GST band, no tender, no contract) was found — следов поставок на экспорт не найдено, и по внутреннему рынку подтверждений тоже нет.
